name: JM Mobile Mechanic

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Braxton Black
reviewSamples.text: Julian was awsome! drove down to Islamorada to diagnose my f250 that I was having break issues with I had a different Mechanic Previously fix it and they did not do a good job. But Julian was more than fair with his prices and his time. He also knows that I use this truck for my business so he made it a priority to get it done within the same day even though that meant him driving all the way up past Homestead to get me the part and come all the way back.  This guy rocks Changed my master cylinder Cleaned everything up, bleed my brakes for me And this is the best my brakes have ever felt I would highly recommend him to anybody in need of a Mobile Mechanic! It’s hard to find people Who are as professional and hard-working !

reviewSamples.author: Photo of jonathan vachiratevanurak
reviewSamples.text: Finally, a mechanic we can trust! Carla in the office was prompt with all of my questions and provided clear estimates. They were able to come to our house faster than I was expecting considering we live pretty far south. Julian worked on our car and was amazing. He will explain exactly what he's going to do and is honest with what is needed, and not needed. Their prices are more than fair, and the quality of work it outstanding. I highly recommend.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jean-Paul Dubois
reviewSamples.text:
I can only praise JM Mobile Mechanic! Extremely professional service, excellent communication and the repairs performed were done in an incredible manner, no mess, no stains on driveway. My go to mechanic from now on.

JM Mobile Mechanic keeps delivering excellent service! I cannot recommend enough.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Joann Bower
reviewSamples.text:
I can honestly say this is one of the most honest and caring mobile mechanics I’ve ever dealt with.

We first contacted them when my boyfriend had an older Corolla (about 26 years old). They really tried to fix everything, but there was one part they just couldn’t find anywhere despite putting in the effort. They did fix a couple of other things, but for that one issue, instead of charging us anyway, they gave a full refund and even sent a YouTube video showing how he could fix the small problem himself to save money. That kind of honesty is rare.

Because of that experience, I never forgot them. Later on, after my mom passed away, my dad wasn’t able to drive far due to his grief. They came out and worked on his car, fixing multiple issues little by little until it was safe and drivable again so he could get to his appointments and the store. That meant a lot to us.

Most recently, my own car broke down, and again they showed up and got everything running smoothly.

They are not only skilled but genuinely caring people who do great work and treat you fairly. I plan on keeping them as my mechanics and referring them to all my friends, family, and coworkers. I highly recommend them!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of William Sumlin
reviewSamples.text:
Ended up wasting $2000 with this mechanic.

A year ago I had him replace Compressor for my AC that ended up going out literally just two weeks after he installed. He claimed the condenser “detached” somehow .
He fixed it and it literally went out again not long after. So fast forward to today, I just took my car to a professional and they informed me the compressor is bad!! JM didn’t know that it is required to change the condenser AND the expansion valve if you change the compressor. I’m typing that out so any potential customer can verify with a real professional before consulting this mechanic.

I’ve never let a review in my life and am having to navigate small claims court for the first time in my whole life because of this service.

He also was late both times he looked at my car and I also caught him on YouTube looking up the issue; I should’ve stopped the service there.

PLEASE AVOID AT ALL COSTS!! I am someone who is still paying for this guys mistakes over a year later! He is not knowledgeable and has the potential to ruin your car.
